name: Something-Something V2
summary: 由人类执行日常物体交互构成的大规模短视频数据集，类别强调推动、放置、遮挡等细粒度时间变化，是学习动作结果与时序因果线索的常用资源。
license: Dataset license and access agreement; commercial use requires review
wmNote: 动作类别依赖时间顺序，适合动态表征预训练；缺少机器人控制与显式物理状态。
summaryEn: A large collection of short human-object interaction videos whose fine-grained labels depend on temporal changes such as pushing, placing, and occluding.
wmNoteEn: Temporal labels support dynamics representation learning, but the dataset provides neither robot controls nor explicit physical state.
scaleZh: 22 万+ 段视频 · 174 个动作类别
licenseZh: 适用数据集许可和访问协议；商业用途需另行审核
